title: wasitme glance (menu bar, popover, desktop panel, Claude Code mod and band, status-line source, CLI)
description: FROZEN at the contract freeze (docs/CONTRACT.md, DECISIONS D22). Written atomically (temp file + rename) by the engine to ~/.wasitme/glance.json (WASITME_HOME overrides ~/.wasitme). The engine writes compact JSON of at most 16 KB. After the freeze only additive changes are allowed, made to this schema and contract/fixtures/ in the same commit. Consumers never validate against this schema: they decode tolerantly, ignore unknown fields, render an unknown state as 'unclear', an unknown reason as null and an unknown side as 'unknown', refuse a document whose privacy.containsText is not the boolean false, show 'Update needed' for any other schema id, and compute the display state 'stale' themselves (docs/CONTRACT.md#display-rules). Every string is engine-owned text: consumers render it as plain text, strip control/format characters and bound it before drawing.

staleAfterSec.description: display 'stale' once now - generatedAt exceeds this (consumer default 7200 when absent)

demo.description: true only for `wasitme demo` output; surfaces show a DEMO ribbon

lead.description: layout: lead with the change timeline or with the verdict (D28)

agents.description: Engine-ordered. A single-glyph surface (menu bar, status line) speaks for agents[0]. Agents are never pooled.

scanError.description: Why the last scan failed, as a kind (never text). null when scanOk is true. Consumers treat an unknown kind as 'internal'.

state.description: D22 verdict state. Display order: insufficient, none, unclear, you, agent. 'stale' is a display state computed by consumers, never written here.

reason.description: The decision-table row's reason (METHOD.md §11), or null when the state needs none (you; agent with an agent-strong candidate; none). insufficient: calibration_pending | needs_data | single_indicator. unclear: mixed | workload | unknown_provenance | both_sides | nothing_recorded_on_your_side | blind_spot. agent: by_elimination | null.

side.description: Who initiated a change (METHOD.md §9). 'unknown' is never 'agent'; 'meta' is wasitme's own writes or a parser change.

family.description: metric family; null for context metrics without one (e.g. churn)

kn.description: integer totals for one window: k events over n opportunities (readsPerEdit: k reads over n edits)

range.description: the interval around the ratio, printed as 'range' (never '99%', D31); null when not computed

mde.description: minimum detectable ratio: changes smaller than this would not show

strip.description: chart data for one metric: daily integer k/n (no per-day bands) plus one window-level ratio, range and MDE. null when there is nothing to chart.

kind.description: engine ChangeKind; consumers show a generic mark for a kind they don't know

new.description: appeared since the previous scan (the menu bar's 'new' mark)

unlock.description: one gate shortfall, shown in sessions and session-days (METHOD.md §13); never for interrupts

progress.description: tier-based progress (METHOD.md §4, §13); null when there is nothing to unlock

tier.description: the tier the ETA refers to

notAtCurrentPace.description: true: no tier gets there at the current pace; etaDate is null and no day count is shown

agentId.description: open string: claude-code, codex, or a future agent

pending.description: a state change is waiting for a second agreeing evaluation; the state shown is the held one

calibrated.description: this agent passed its own null calibration (D23); false means state insufficient, reason calibration_pending

label.description: state label, e.g. 'Too early to tell'

band.description: the Claude Code band line; empty unless band-eligible
